name: hrm
label: HRM (Human Resource Management)
description: Full HR lifecycle — legal entities, org structure, jobs, people, employment, compensation, payroll, leave, timesheets, and performance

table_notes.hrm_legal_entity: Employer legal entity that runs payroll. One tenant can operate multiple legal entities in different countries. payroll_currency and fiscal_year_start_month drive payrun scheduling.
table_notes.hrm_organization: Org chart node (division, department, team, or unit). Self-referencing parent_id builds the hierarchy. manager_id is a soft FK to hrm_person.id managed by the application.
table_notes.hrm_job_catalog: Centralised job architecture library. pay_range_min/max define the approved salary band for the grade. flsa_status drives overtime eligibility in US-jurisdiction payrolls.
table_notes.hrm_person: Demographic master record for every individual. Sensitive fields (national_id_encrypted, tax_id_encrypted) are application-level encrypted before storage. One person may have multiple sequential hrm_employment records.
table_notes.hrm_employment: A single engagement contract between a person and a legal entity. Tracks org placement, employment type, probation, and termination metadata. Multiple active records indicate concurrent employments.
table_notes.hrm_compensation: Effective-dated pay record. A new row is inserted for every pay change; the current rate is the row with the highest effective_date <= today. Supports salary, hourly, commission, and daily pay types.
table_notes.hrm_payrun: Payroll batch header covering a pay period for one legal entity. Totals are accumulated from hrm_payslip rows. status drives the approval workflow: DRAFT -> APPROVED -> PROCESSED -> PAID.
table_notes.hrm_payslip: Per-employee summary within a payrun. All monetary fields are in the entity's payroll_currency. bank_account_iban is the destination for net pay disbursement.
table_notes.hrm_payslip_line: Itemised earnings and deduction lines composing a payslip. units * rate = amount for hourly/commission lines; amount is set directly for fixed amounts. gl_account_code links to the general ledger chart of accounts.
table_notes.hrm_leave_policy: Leave entitlement rules per legal entity and leave type. accrual_frequency controls when entitlement accrues; carry_over_max caps year-end balance rollover.
table_notes.hrm_leave_balance: Running leave balance per employee per year. remaining = accrued + carried_over - taken - pending. Recomputed nightly and on every leave action.
table_notes.hrm_leave_request: Employee leave application. days_requested is computed by the application from start_date/end_date excluding weekends and public holidays.
table_notes.hrm_timesheet: Weekly timesheet header per employee. status transitions: DRAFT -> SUBMITTED -> APPROVED | REJECTED. Approved hours feed payrun processing for hourly employees.
table_notes.hrm_time_entry: Daily time entry within a timesheet. project_code and cost_center enable project-based cost allocation and billing.
table_notes.hrm_performance_review: Structured appraisal record. overall_rating is set by the reviewer; calibrated_rating is the HR-adjusted score after calibration sessions. Supports annual, mid-year, probation, and 360-degree review types.

short_description: Full HR lifecycle — legal entities, org structure, jobs, people, employment, compensation, payroll, leave, timesheets, and performance
long_description: Comprehensive Human Resource Management schema covering the complete hire-to-retire lifecycle. hrm_legal_entity and hrm_organization model the employer structure and org chart hierarchy. hrm_job_catalog provides a centralised job architecture library with pay bands. hrm_person holds demographic master data with application-level encryption for sensitive fields. hrm_employment tracks each contract engagement with full termination metadata. hrm_compensation uses effective-dated rows for immutable pay history. hrm_payrun and hrm_payslip implement a full payroll batch processing model with per-employee itemised hrm_payslip_line entries for GL integration. hrm_leave_policy and hrm_leave_balance manage entitlements and running balances; hrm_leave_request handles the approval workflow. hrm_timesheet and hrm_time_entry capture weekly hours with project and cost-centre allocation. hrm_performance_review supports multiple review types with calibration.
when_to_use: Use for any SaaS HR platform, ERP HR module, or workforce management system that needs to manage employee data, process payroll, track leave entitlements, capture timesheets, and run performance reviews. Pairs naturally with the GL template for payroll journal posting and with tenant-aware multi-entity setups.
